name: Jucal
overview: Jucal is a male figure mentioned in the Bible, specifically identified as the son of Shelemiah. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details beyond his paternal connection. His mention is brief and limited to a single scriptural reference.
namesAndTitles: The name Jucal means 'y-h-v-h is capable,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's power. This proper name is recorded in Jeremiah 38:1 and is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jucal as the son of Shelemiah. No further family relationships or connections are documented in the biblical text beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Jucal's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his identification as the son of Shelemiah, placing him within the historical context of Jeremiah 38:1. While the passage does not elaborate on his role, his mention situates him among individuals involved in the events surrounding the prophet Jeremiah. His brief mention underscores the historical and genealogical record-keeping present in Scripture.
